content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-102. - Attendance and punctuality.

faqs.a:
Employees are required to be in attendance at their work location in accordance with
               their job assignment and approved work schedule. Employees are expected to be at work
               on all scheduled work days and during all scheduled work hours and to report to work
               on time. Employees must report any absences and tardiness according to the guidelines
               determined by the employee's appointing authority.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
